why: Russian Menaion Reader plate «08131»: church-month 08 = April, day 13, this folder's Russian, Romanian and Serbian feast. The plate is titled «Артемон»; the Russian Lives keep one Artemon on 13 April, the hieromartyr presbyter of Laodicea, which is this folder's Russian form «Артемон Лаодикийский». NOT `artemon-of-seleucia`, the bishop, whose day in the same book is 24 March. The day's only other plate is «Фомаида».

file: File:Жития Святых (1903-1911) - икона 10201 Аристоклий, Димитриан и Афанасий.png
why: Russian Menaion Reader plate «10201»: church-month 10 = June, day 20, this folder's Russian and Serbian feast. The plate's title names the three Cypriot martyrs together — «Аристоклий, Димитриан и Афанасий» — and this folder IS the Athanasius of that trio: its Russian form is «Афанасий Саламинский (Кипрский), мч.» and its display name «Athanasius the Reader», the reader martyred with the presbyter Aristocles and the deacon Demetrian at Salamis in Cyprus. A three-figure plate, so the hero shows his two companions beside him; the plate names him.

Russian Menaion Reader plate «08091»: church-month 08 = April, day 9, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate is titled «Евпсихий»; the Russian Lives keep one Eupsychius on 9 April, the martyr of Caesarea in Cappadocia, which is this folder's Russian form «Евпсихий Кесарийский (Каппадокийский)». The day's only other plate is «Вадим».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «08092»: church-month 08 = April, day 9, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate is titled «Вадим», this folder's own Russian form «Вадим Персидский», and the Russian Lives keep one Vadim in the whole year. The day's only other plate is «Евпсихий».

file: File:Жития Святых (1903-1911) - икона 11121 Прокл и Иларий.png
why: Russian Menaion Reader plate «11121»: church-month 11 = July, day 12, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate's title is «Прокл и Иларий» — Proclus and Hilary — and this folder is literally that Hilary: its slug and display name are «Hilary, companion of Proclus» and its Russian form «Иларий Калиптский», the nephew martyred with Proclus at Callipolis. A two-figure plate naming both, so the hero shows the pair the folder is half of.

Russian Menaion Reader plate «07241»: church-month 07 = March, day 24, which is this folder's second Russian attestation day (it also carries 21 March). The plate is titled «Иаков» and is the only plate the series carries for 24 March; the Russian Lives keep one James on that day, the confessor and bishop of Catania, which is this folder's Russian form «Иаков Катанский (Сицилийский)».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «08181»: church-month 08 = April, day 18, this folder's Romanian and Serbian feast. The Russian Lives keep two Johns on 18 April and the series draws them as separate plates: «08182 Иоанн Новый», John the New of Ioannina, and this one, the bare «Иоанн», which is the day's «Прп. Иоанна, ученика св. Григория Декаполита» — the disciple of Gregory the Decapolite, exactly this folder, whose Russian form is «Иоанн Солунский (Фессалоникийский)». The New Martyr of Ioannina is explicitly NOT taken.

Russian Menaion Reader plate «08191»: church-month 08 = April, day 19, this folder's Russian, Romanian and Serbian feast. The plate is titled «Иоанн» and is the only John on that day in the series — the other two plates are «Георгий» and «Трифон». The Russian Lives keep one John on 19 April, «Прп. Иоанна Ветхопещерника», John of the Old Lavra, which is this folder's Russian form «Иоанн Палеолаврит, Ветхопещерник».

file: File:Жития Святых (1903-1911) - икона 10212 Иулий и Иулиан.png
why: Russian Menaion Reader plate «10212»: church-month 10 = June, day 21, this folder's Russian and Serbian feast. The plate's title is «Иулий и Иулиан», Julius and Julian — the presbyter and his brother the deacon, which is this folder's Russian form «Иулий Мирмидонянин» and its `presbyter` and `preacher` types. The day's other plate, the solo «10211 Иулиан», is NOT taken: a lone Julian on 21 June is the martyr of Tarsus and a different man.

Russian Menaion Reader plate «07151»: church-month 07 = March, day 15, this folder's Russian, Greek and Serbian feast. The plate is titled «Никандр»; the Russian Lives keep one Nicander on 15 March, the Egyptian physician, which is this folder's Russian form «Никандр Египтянин» and its `physician` type. NOT `nicander-of-myra` (4 November) nor `nicander-of-durostorum`. The day's only other plate is «Александр».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «11291»: church-month 11 = July, day 29, this folder's Russian and Serbian feast. The plate is titled «Серафима», which is this folder's own Russian name form (stored twice, as «Серафима» and «Серафима Римская»); the Russian Lives keep one on 29 July, «Мц. Серафимы девы», the virgin martyr, which is this folder's `virgin` and `martyr`. The day's only other plate is «Каллиник».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «11131»: church-month 11 = July, day 13, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate is titled «Стефан»; the Russian Lives keep one Stephen on 13 July, «Прп. Стефана Савваита», which is this folder's Russian form «Стефан Савваит». The day's only other plate is «Иулиан».
